headline: Frontline Flux Grows Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours on, the map still shows a largely static front, but the tempo of ownership changes has quickened on a half‑dozen sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest theatre, its daily flips climbing to 62 from 51, with Colonial losses rising to 8,603 and Warden losses to 14,062 while fresh enlistments dip to 443. Callahans Passage steadies at 29 flips, yet casualties climb to 9,872 Colonial and 12,305 Warden, enlistments edging up to 852. Fishermans Row nudges to 33 flips, casualties barely moving at 389 Colonial and 528 Warden, enlistments rising to 199. Stlican Shelf surges to 23 flips, Colonial dead easing to 2,397 while Warden dead reach 2,638, enlistments falling to 268. Mooring County holds at 12 flips, Colonial casualties slipping to 5,849 but Warden casualties climbing to 7,210, enlistments at 647. Stema Landing remains at nine flips with modest losses of 21 Colonial and 12 Warden, enlistments 64. Meanwhile, previously quiet Linn Mercy, Palantine Berm and Nevish Line have each recorded their first flips this cycle, signalling new pressure points. All other regions report no ownership activity.
